syllabus: A district judge has no authority to sign a citation upon a writ ot error to a State court. When the citation has been thus signed, the writ of error will be dismissed on motion.
summary: This was a motion,: made by Mr. J. H. Bradley, to dismiss a writ of error directed to the Supreme Court of the State of California, on the. ground that the citation had Been signed by a district judge, which the record showed was the fact.
